overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not approving its November 2012 minutes timely, but because the Board approved them after the complaint, no further relief was ordered; the CAO supervision allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to approve minutes of its three November 2012 meetings in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board did not comply with the Law's requirements regarding the timely approval of minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Chief Administrative Officer failed to supervise staff, which the AG declined to review as internal town operations.
allegations.key_passage: This determination concerns only compliance with the Open Meeting Law, thus we decline to review allegations about the internal operations of the Town.
